documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: JG Chemicals Limited reported its best-ever quarterly performance in Q1 FY27, driven by strong demand across end-user applications and disciplined execution. The company is expanding its manufacturing footprint with greenfield and brownfield projects in Dahej and Naidupeta targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27. Management highlighted robust volume growth across vehicle categories in the tire industry and noted ongoing product innovation and R&D advancements. Furthermore, the company remains focused on increasing the share of non-rubber and higher value-added products to improve overall EBITDA margins. J.G.

guidance.claim: The company expects the Dahej plant utilization to reach a minimum of 50% to 60% in the first full year of operations.
guidance.quote: I would say when we talk about next financial year, which is the first full year of operations, we should be looking at minimum 50% to 60%.

guidance.claim: Management targets an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with a higher share of value-added products.
guidance.quote: So, going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

demand_outlook.claim: Volume growth across major vehicle categories saw year-on-year increases in Q1 FY27 as reported by ATMA.
demand_outlook.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, continuing into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as demand is concerned, our customers, the tire and the rubber, remain the largest pillar of our business, and demand momentum across the tire industry remained robust through the previous quarter and Q4 ending FY26, and this has continued into the current quarter also.

demand_outlook.claim: The company continues to see encouraging traction in non-rubber segments such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.
demand_outlook.quote: As far as the non-rubber applications are concerned, outside the rubber and tire, we continue to see encouraging traction in the non-rubber segment such as pharmaceuticals, ceramics, specialty chemicals, and agri.

demand_outlook.claim: The company witnessed strong demand and volume growth across all end-user applications during Q1 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Strong demand and volume growth was witnessed across all end user applications.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand momentum across the tire industry was extremely robust through the fourth quarter and has continued into the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand momentum across tire industry was extremely robust right through the fourth quarter and the same momentum has continued in the current quarter as well as we speak.

demand_outlook.claim: The tire industry continues to benefit meaningfully from GST-led reforms.
demand_outlook.quote: The tire industry continues to benefit meaningfully from the GST-led reforms.

demand_outlook.claim: Management currently does not witness any slowdown from the tire industry and has a very healthy order book.
demand_outlook.quote: So, currently we are not witnessing any slowdown from the tire industry and what we hear that the demand for tires is quite strong in the market and even our projections what they have given for the month of June are almost at par with what was there in April and May.

capex_expansion.claim: The Dahej greenfield facility involves an investment of about INR100 crores with an estimated revenue potential of INR900 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: The brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the Dahej project will add 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum with a revenue potential of INR300 crores to INR400 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1, as I just mentioned in the previous question, would be in the range of 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum, and the revenue potential would be in the range of INR300 crores to INR400 crores

capex_expansion.claim: The company has undertaken certain brownfield debottlenecking expansions at Naidupeta to support future demand.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside Dahej, we have also undertaken certain brownfield debottlenecking expansions at Naidupeta to support the future demand.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the solar power generation project at Naidupeta was commissioned in FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to inform you that we have commissioned Phase 1 of our solar power generation project at Naidupeta in FY26, which has progressively been ramping up our share of renewable energy.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated revenue from operations for Q1 FY27 was INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8%.
margins_costs.quote: For Q1 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and increasing 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA for the current quarter was INR36.3 crores with a margin of 11.5% as compared to 10.64% in the corresponding quarter last year.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for Q1 FY27 was INR26.1 crores with a margin of 8.27% compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: The PAT for the quarter was INR26.1 crores with a PAT margin of 8.27% as compared to 7.52% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: All incremental costs including higher freight, energy, and ancillary costs have been transparently passed on to customers effective April 1, 2026.
margins_costs.quote: In line with our long-standing pricing philosophy, all of these incremental costs, including higher freight, energy, and other ancillary costs, have been transparently passed on to all our customers with effect from 1st April 2026 itself.

margins_costs.claim: Current EBITDA margins are usually in the 10% to 11% range.
margins_costs.quote: So, you see our current EBITDA margins are usually in the 10% to 11% range, and as we've mentioned before, higher value-added products would help increase the blended margins to the 13% to 14% range.

margins_costs.claim: Any gains on account of zinc price movement and inventory will be retained by the company and not passed on.
margins_costs.quote: So, going forward, any gains on account of zinc price movement and on the inventory will be retained by the company and not passed on.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined zinc chemical installed capacity at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh facilities is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together today command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream.
orders_capacity.quote: With the addition of Gujarat project targeted for commissioning in Q3 FY27, and once both phases of the Dahej plant are on stream, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 1,15,000 metric tons per annum, a scale that would position us amongst the top three zinc chemical producers globally.

orders_capacity.claim: Utilization levels are in the early 80s.
orders_capacity.quote: So, the utilization levels are in early 80s right now as we speak.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined installed manufacturing capacity at West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh is close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Our manufacturing is anchored at our facilities in West Bengal and Andhra Pradesh, which together command an installed capacity of close to 70,000 metric tons per annum.

orders_capacity.claim: Current zinc oxide capacity utilization rates are in the late 70s.
orders_capacity.quote: Our current utilization rates are in the late 70s, and we can easily take this up to the 86% to 87% range as required.

orders_capacity.claim: Zinc sulphate capacity is running at approximately 60% of installed capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: The zinc sulphate business, which has gradually been growing, is today running at approximately 60% of the installed capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE as a wholly-owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company has also proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE, which upon incorporation will become a wholly owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited, a material subsidiary of JG Chemicals, and consequently a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary of JG Chemicals Limited.

risks_headwinds.claim: Ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, the primary raw material.
risks_headwinds.quote: As we had mentioned earlier, the ongoing geopolitical conflict had impacted global supply chains for Zinc Dross, which is our primary raw material.

risks_headwinds.claim: Despite global supply chain disruptions, JGC's scale and relationships ensured uninterrupted raw material supply.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite global supply chain disruption, JGC's scale, financial strength and long term supplier relationships have ensured uninterrupted supply of raw material during the last few months.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts and ongoing war caused disruptions and a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East during March.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the month of March, there was a complete freeze in imports from the Middle East and also there were huge delays in shipments from Europe.

risks_headwinds.claim: March was characterized by a sudden spike in energy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Moreover, March was also characterized by a sudden spike in energy prices.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commission Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production at the Dahej facility in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commission the brownfield expansion at the Naidupeta facility in Q3 of the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company hopes to commercially start the recycled rubber project in the next 12 months.
management_commitments.quote: And we hope that in the next 12 months, we should be able to commercially start this project

management_commitments.claim: The Dahej greenfield facility is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned in Q3 FY27.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commission the Naidupeta brownfield expansion in Q3 FY27.
management_commitments.quote: The Naidupeta brownfield is progressing in parallel and we expect to commission that also in Q3 FY27

management_commitments.claim: The company targets increasing the contribution of non-rubber revenues from 15% to 30% over the next few years.
management_commitments.quote: increasing the contribution of non-rubber revenues from the current 15% to 30% over the next few years.

management_commitments.claim: Once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream by 2029, combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum.
management_commitments.quote: With the Gujarat project being commissioned during the current financial year, and once both phases at the Dahej plant are on stream by 2029, our combined zinc chemical capacity will exceed 115,000 metric tons per annum, a scale which is perhaps matched today globally by only a few players.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to completely debottleneck the Naidupeta facility by December 2026.
management_commitments.quote: So, this is a gradual process which is going on, and we expect that by December 2026, we'll have completely debottlenecked this facility.

management_commitments.claim: For the Gujarat plant, capacity utilization is expected to reach about 35% to 40% for the operating period in the current year.
management_commitments.quote: I think we should get to about 35% to 40% range for that period.

management_commitments.claim: For the next financial year (FY28), the Gujarat plant utilization should reach about 65% to 70%.
management_commitments.quote: And for the full year which is the next financial year which is FY28, we should get to about 65% to 70% utilization for that plant.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
